_en: English renderings of the lines above, shown on the dashboard so non-Bangla readers can see what residents receive. Alerts themselves go out in Bangla.

drivers_en.log_runoff: heavy rain is forecast, and with so much paved ground the water will collect on the streets quickly
drivers_en.twi_z: the area is low and water from around it flows here
drivers_en.low_elev_share: much of the ward lies below 4 m, so water drains away slowly
drivers_en.built_share: dense buildings and paved roads keep rainwater from soaking into the ground
drivers_en.vulnerability: many people here live in crowded housing or in households at higher risk

yellow: Follow the rain news and local warnings
Keep the drain openings in front of homes and shops clear
orange: Lift shop goods, electrical items and important papers off the floor
Put water, dry food, medicine and a torch together in one place
Avoid walking or driving through standing water
red: Move goods, medicine and papers up high now
Stay away from power lines, poles and open manholes in or near standing water
Check on elderly, young and sick neighbours
